intro: Chile is a land of poets, with two Nobel Prize winners for literature.

chapters.title: Poets
text: Gabriela Mistral was the first Latin American Nobel winner in literature, in 1945, and Pablo Neruda won in 1971. Isabel Allende is one of the most read Spanish-language novelists.

chapters.title: Food
text: Empanadas de pino, pastel de choclo (corn pie) and completos (loaded hot dogs) are favourites.
